item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Exploring Bioactivity of Natural Compounds: From Encapsulation Strategies to Drug Discovery for Biomedical Targets (BRIDGE) (Univ. BOLZANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-24 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLZANO, Bolzano
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-07 Scienze e tecnologie alimentari

The project aims to investigate natural compounds derived from grape and apple by-products as potential inhibitors of protein aggregation associated with Huntington's disease and other neurodegenerative disorders. As part of a broader multi-institutional research project, the researcher's work at UNIBZ will focus on optimizing sustainable extraction and purification methods to recover bioactive molecules—specifically polyphenols—from grape pomace and apple peels. Particular attention will be paid to ultrasound-assisted extraction, microwave-assisted extraction, and supercritical CO2 extraction. item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Assessing and modeling ecosystem carbon and water fluxes in apple orchards (Univ. BOLZANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-04 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLZANO, Bolzano
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-03 Scienze e tecnologie dei sistemi arborei e forestali

The research project focuses on carbon, water, and energy fluxes between the soil–plant system and the atmosphere in apple orchards. Activities will include collecting meteorological and flux data using an eddy covariance station, assessing data quality for processing, generating indicators such as NEP, GPP, NECB, and ET, and developing predictive models in the context of climate change. The contractor will also be expected to perform routine and extraordinary maintenance of the eddy covariance system, ensure remote data transmission, and relocate the system to other sites for short measurement campaigns.
